question: Can you provide the total number of sessions for each traffic channel in December 2020, using the information from the 'event_params'
sql:
WITH event_params_extracted AS (
  SELECT 
    event_date,
    (SELECT MAX(CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING)) 
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id,
    (SELECT MAX(ep.value.string_value) 
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'medium') AS medium,
    (SELECT MAX(ep.value.string_value) 
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'source') AS source,
    (SELECT MAX(ep.value.string_value) 
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'campaign') AS campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    event_date,
    ANY_VALUE(medium) AS medium,
    ANY_VALUE(source) AS source,
    ANY_VALUE(campaign) AS campaign
  FROM event_params_extracted
  GROUP BY session_id, event_date
),
session_channels AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    event_date,
    medium,
    source,
    campaign,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(campaign) LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR (campaign IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping')))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
           OR (campaign IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping')) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'video') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_params
),
session_first_channel AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    channel,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_date) AS rn
  FROM session_channels
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
FROM session_first_channel
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC
